body: Built and run by our team in the Philippines, alongside your store team.

images.slotName: IMG-23-1 · A swallow finds the blossom

content.heading: The work behind a growing store.
content.lead: Every new product and every busy week means more writing, more answering and more retyping.

items.title: Writing product pages
items.text: Every new product needs a description, details and images before it can go live.

items.title: The same questions, all day
items.text: Sizes, delivery and returns, asked again and again by email and chat.

items.title: Shoppers who can’t find it
items.text: Search only goes so far when a shopper doesn’t know what the product is called.

items.title: Orders typed twice
items.text: Orders from email and marketplaces get retyped into your system.

sections.note: Descriptions of common manual work, written as the problem; no figures, no claims about how long anything takes.

content.heading: AI answers first. You make it right.
content.lead: A sample of how one shopper’s questions move through the package. We map your real steps with your team before we build.

items.text: A shopper asks in chat which size to order.
The assistant checks your size guide and answers.
It suggests a matching product from your catalog.
Later, the shopper reports a parcel that arrived damaged.
The assistant passes the case to your team with the order details.
Your team arranges the refund or replacement.

content.heading: Your customers’ data stays yours.
content.lead: Orders, addresses and chats are your customers’ details, so they stay in your own systems wherever possible.

items.title: Never used for training
items.text: We never use your data to train anything you don’t own.

items.title: A person checks the work
items.text: A person reviews every piece of work before it reaches you, including content before it goes live.

items.title: Harder cases go to people
items.text: The assistant passes anything it can’t handle to your team, with the details attached.

items.title: Protected by law
items.text: Personal data in the Philippines is protected by the Data Privacy Act of 2012, enforced by an independent National Privacy Commission.

sources.text: Republic Act No. 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012. Supreme Court E-Library. Retrieved 2026-11-02.

notes: Built from the shared industry template. Package items are the Brand DNA online stores and retail list (product content, shopping assistants, recommendations, customer support); the related services reuse Brand DNA wording (Selling through AI assistants, Forecasting, Email marketing, AI search visibility). Content is checked by a person before it goes live (Brand DNA: written with AI and checked by people). No conversion, sales or traffic figures. The hero link “See what’s in the package” jumps to the #package section. Titles are set on balanced lines in Figma (a line break, and on mobile a few extra breaks); in code use text-wrap: balance. Review 2026-11-03 (builder): every frame passes the lint with no findings; sample-step tints are 10% Ribbon Cyan, re-applied after the build. Review 2026-11-03 (reviewer): the hero meta now names the Philippines base (globe icon); “a person checks every description” stays in the package card and the data promise, where it was already said twice; the sample headline now ends “You make it right.” so its accent is no longer a second “first.” (the closing CTA keeps it); services list regrouped into an aligned grid. Every frame lint-clean afterwards.
